_meta.source: Bureau of Indian Standards - IS 302-2-14:2009, IS 302-1:2009, IS 694:2010, IS 1293:2019
_meta.note: Each pattern describes ONE verifiable requirement from a BIS standard clause. Evidence keywords are searched in ExtractedField values. If NO evidence keyword is found in ANY field, the pattern generates a compliance finding.

patterns.requirement_text: This standard applies to motor-driven domestic kitchen machines with a rated voltage not exceeding 250V single-phase for use in households. Rated power must not exceed 1000W.
patterns.gap_description: Product does not appear to fall within the scope of IS 302-2-14 based on submitted documentation.
patterns.recommended_action: Confirm product is a domestic single-phase kitchen machine with rated voltage <= 250V and power <= 1000W and explicitly state this in the product description.

patterns.requirement_text: The appliance nameplate shall explicitly display: rated voltage or voltage range in Volts (e.g. '230 V' or '220-240 V'), nature of supply (~) or '50 Hz', rated power input in Watts (W), and the manufacturer's name or trademark.
patterns.gap_description: No evidence of complete nameplate marking data (voltage, frequency, wattage) found in submitted specification documents.
patterns.recommended_action: Revise nameplate engineering drawing to incorporate '230 V AC, 50 Hz, 750 W' adjacent to the ISI Mark placeholder. Verify against IS 302-1 Clause 7 marking requirements before factory pre-audit.

patterns.requirement_text: The appliance shall be classified as Class I (earthed) or Class II (double insulated). The classification shall be stated on the nameplate and in technical documentation.
patterns.gap_description: Insulation class (Class I or Class II) not declared in submitted documentation.
patterns.recommended_action: Explicitly state insulation class (Class I - earthed, or Class II - double insulated) in both the product specification sheet and the nameplate artwork.

patterns.requirement_text: Leakage current from accessible conductive parts shall not exceed 0.75 mA (Class I) or 0.25 mA (Class II) under normal operating conditions.
patterns.gap_description: No leakage current test result or insulation resistance value found in submitted test evidence.
patterns.recommended_action: Include leakage current measurement results (target: <0.5 mA for Class I) from an accredited BIS laboratory in the technical dossier.

patterns.requirement_text: Dielectric strength: 1500 V AC must be applied between live conductors and accessible metal parts for 60 seconds without breakdown. Leakage current during test must be <5 mA.
patterns.gap_description: No dielectric strength (flash) test evidence at 1500V found in submitted test records.
patterns.recommended_action: Attach calibrated flash tester records showing 1500 V AC applied for 60 s with zero breakdown. Update QA test plan to include this as a mandatory routine test.

patterns.requirement_text: Motor must undergo 30-second locked-rotor abnormal operation test. Winding insulation temperature must not exceed 150 degrees C. Thermal overload protector (TOP) must trip safely without fire or flame.
patterns.gap_description: No locked-rotor thermal overload trip test evidence found in submitted documentation.
patterns.recommended_action: Conduct locked-rotor trip endurance test on 3 production samples per Clause 19.11. Attach calibrated temperature-rise curve data showing TOP trips before 150 degrees C winding temperature is exceeded.

patterns.requirement_text: Appliance must be fitted with means to prevent unintentional starting after power interruption. Safety interlock or lid switch must be documented.
patterns.gap_description: No evidence of safety interlock or restart-prevention mechanism found in product specification.
patterns.recommended_action: Document the lid-interlock or power-restart protection mechanism in the product specification, with reference to the relevant IS 302-2-14 clause and circuit diagram.

patterns.requirement_text: Flexible supply cord must be of at least 0.75 mm2 cross-sectional area, 3-core (live, neutral, earth), certified under BIS IS 694 ISI-marked with a valid vendor CM/L licence number.
patterns.gap_description: Supply cord IS 694 certification (CM/L licence) not found in submitted Bill of Materials or test certificate.
patterns.recommended_action: Procure IS 694 ISI-marked 3-core 0.75 mm2 flexible cord from a BIS-licensed vendor and include the vendor's CM/L number in the Bill of Materials and technical dossier.

patterns.requirement_text: Earth resistance between accessible metal parts and the earthing pin shall not exceed 0.1 ohm, verified with a test current of 25 A for 1 second.
patterns.gap_description: Quantitative earth continuity resistance measurement not found in submitted QA records - binary pass/fail is insufficient.
patterns.recommended_action: Update QA inspection logs to record numerical resistance values (target: < 0.05 ohm) using a calibrated milliohmmeter for BIS factory audit compliance.

patterns.requirement_text: Fitted 6A 3-pin plug must comply with IS 1293:2019, with mandatory insulated sleeves on live and neutral pins to the 2019 revision dimensional gauge.
patterns.gap_description: 3-pin plug compliance with IS 1293:2019 pin sleeve dimensions not verified in submitted specification.
patterns.recommended_action: Provide dimensional drawing and Certificate of Conformity for the moulded plug verifying compliance with IS 1293:2019 Table 1 gauge specifications.

patterns.requirement_text: Instructions for use must be supplied in the language of the country of destination (Hindi and/or regional language for India). Safety warnings must be printed on durable labels.
patterns.gap_description: No user instruction manual or safety labelling document found in the submitted technical dossier.
patterns.recommended_action: Prepare a bilingual (English + Hindi) user manual and safety label artwork and include in the technical file.

patterns.requirement_text: The appliance must be fitted with a thermal cut-out or equivalent over-temperature protection that disconnects the heating element before thermal damage occurs.
patterns.gap_description: No thermal cut-out or over-temperature protection device documented in specification.
patterns.recommended_action: Document the thermal overload protector (TOP) specifications including trip temperature, reset type (manual/auto) in the product technical file.
